name: Vanilla Latte
caffeineNote: Label: 200 mg per can, printed on the front; caffeine is also added as an ingredient, on top of what the coffee carries
summary: Zero-sugar vanilla cold brew on oat milk from the Holliston, Massachusetts brand. The can prints 200 mg of caffeine, 0 g of sugar and 80 calories on the front of an 11 fl oz can, and the nutrition panel agrees: 0 g total and 0 g added sugars, with 1 g of protein. The sweetness comes from sucralose, the last ingredient on the label, and caffeine is added on top of the coffee itself.
